description: Search across 519 endpoints in 60 APIs (amenomi, cultural, earth, energy-calc, green-path, harmonias, hydrogen, internal, nanobase, nanosnap, natura, platform, sakurahub, science, sim, space, stocks). Returns matching endpoints with method, path, summary, parameters, and a ready-to-run example. Use this to discover available API endpoints before calling execute_api. Results carry a "coverage" field (e.g. ["JP"]) for region-limited APIs; use the "region" filter to narrow.
